findings.title: assertJson overflows the stack on circular input instead of throwing the documented error
findings.why: `assertJson` recurses with no cycle check. A circular object or array passed to `applyPatch`, `applyMergePatch` or `createPatch` throws a raw `RangeError`. The README and doc comments say non-JSON input is rejected with `JsonPatchError` (or `JsonMergePatchError`), so a caller catching that class misses this case.

findings.title: Lexical declaration directly in a `case` clause
findings.why: `const expected` is declared in `case "test":` without a block, unlike the `move`/`copy` case, which uses braces. It compiles, but it breaks the file's own style and the usual `no-case-declarations` lint rule.

findings.title: Test case A.15 duplicates A.14
findings.why: Both cases are the same patch on the same document, `test /~01` with value 10. The A.15 label says 'number vs string', but nothing compares a number with a string.

findings.title: Plan names a module that does not exist
findings.why: The plan says `resolvePointer` lives in `src/pointer.ts`. It is implemented in `src/index.ts`, and there is no `src/pointer.ts`. The README also has a stray 'sections 3' for the pointer syntax (it should say section 3).
